aoj_give_hint: Use an item (1-8) to hand it over
aoj_piece_jarltable_desc: Heart of a settlement: founding, roles and the settlement area.
aoj_msg_only_jarl: Only the Jarl can do that
aoj_msg_cannot_remove: Only the Jarl can take down the Jarl's Table
aoj_msg_nobody_follows: Nobody follows you here - bring settlers into the settlement area
aoj_read_only: You are a guest here - members (Karl and up) can act
aoj_bed_none: none - build a free bed in the settlement
aoj_activity_nochest: has nowhere to put things - build a chest
aoj_storage_none: No chests in the settlement - build one within the table's radius and settlers will put things in it
aoj_wheel_hint: Quick orders: key $1 - the command wheel for the settler you look at (from afar too) or for your squad (target: the creature in your sight); G - Commands group
aoj_cmd_follow_desc: Nearby settlers who follow nobody follow you
aoj_cmd_attack_desc: They attack the creature you are looking at
aoj_cmd_fallback_desc: They break off the fight and come back to you
aoj_msg_cmd_no_target: Look at the creature they should attack
aoj_cmd_call_desc: Runs over to you and follows you
aoj_cmd_attack_one: Attacks the nearest enemy around it
aoj_cmd_fallback_one: Breaks off the fight and comes back to you
aoj_cmd_home_one: Returns to its settlement and its work
aoj_msg_cmd_lost: The settler is out of reach
aoj_msg_cmd_not_yours: $1 won't take this order from you
aoj_msg_cmd_refused: Nobody in your squad takes this order from you
aoj_msg_max_tier: The settlement has reached its highest tier
aoj_activity_nofood: hungry - no food in the Settlement Cauldron
aoj_alert_beds: Without a bed: $1 - build free beds in the settlement
aoj_alert_food: The Settlement Cauldron is empty - settlers go hungry
aoj_alert_work: Someone has a problem at work - see the Work tab
aoj_banner_wall_desc: Archers' post - put it on a wall or a tower
aoj_banner_gate_desc: Shieldbearers hold the gate and breaches
aoj_banner_shelter_desc: Civilians hide here during an alarm
aoj_chr_feast: A feast! Morale is up for two days
aoj_chr_lost: $1 leaves the settlement (died or went missing)
aoj_chr_siege_faded: The siege petered out - nobody was home
aoj_chr_siege_won: The siege was beaten off! Fame +$1
aoj_defense_hint: Give settlers a role (settler window) and build War Banners; soldiers take gear from the Armory. The alarm sounds by itself when enemies enter the settlement.
aoj_job_locked: a higher settlement tier unlocks this job
aoj_job_hint_woodcutter: Fells trees in the zone, chops the logs and carries the wood to the chests.
aoj_job_hint_hauler: Gathers items in the zone and empties the chest next to the totem (the input chest), sorting everything into the settlement's chests.
aoj_job_hint_miner: Breaks rocks and deposits in the zone (as far as its pickaxe allows) and carries stone and ore away.
aoj_job_hint_smelter: Feeds ore and fuel from the chests to the furnaces, kilns and other stations in the zone.
aoj_job_hint_builder: Repairs damaged buildings in the zone.
aoj_job_hint_farmer: Harvests ripe crops in the zone and plants them again (seeds from the chests). A player prepares the field with the cultivator.
aoj_job_hint_cook: Cooks raw food from the chests on the stations in the zone and puts the dishes into the Settlement Cauldron.
aoj_msg_castaways: Castaways reached the shore! Find them (pin on the map)
aoj_msg_catchup: While you were away the settlement worked:
aoj_msg_feast: A feast! Settlers will be merrier for two days
aoj_msg_feast_needs: A feast needs 1 mead and $1 portions of food in your inventory
aoj_msg_freed: $1 is free and follows you - accept them at the Jarl's Table
aoj_msg_guards_alive: The guards are still alive ($1) - beat them or break the bars
aoj_msg_no_free_settler: No free settler in this settlement
aoj_msg_no_totems: The settlement has no Work Totems
aoj_msg_totem_full: The totem has all the workers it takes
aoj_piece_armory_desc: A chest the settlement's troop takes weapons, shields, armour and arrows from.
aoj_piece_banner_desc: A post for the troop: Rally, Wall (archers), Gate (shieldbearers) or Shelter for civilians. [E] changes the kind.
aoj_piece_cauldron_desc: Put cooked food in here; settlers eat from it twice a day.
aoj_problem_miserable: refuses to work - morale too low
aoj_problem_no_input: put a chest next to the totem
aoj_problem_totem_gone: its totem is far away or gone
aoj_tool_hint: give it to the worker: drag it onto them from your inventory
aoj_totem_desc: Build it in the settlement; assigned settlers work in its zone (radius 8-30 m).
aoj_totem_outside: the totem stands too far from any settlement
aoj_problem_tool_too_weak: the tool is too weak for what is in the zone
aoj_bark_hungry: My belly growls... and there is no food anywhere.
aoj_bark_nochest: I have nowhere to put this.
aoj_msg_totem_refund: Upgrade refused, the materials are back in your inventory
aoj_work_hint: Assign workers in the totem's window ([E] on the totem) or the settler's window (Job button).
aoj_work_none: No totems - build a Woodcutter's or Hauler's Totem (hammer, Misc)
aoj_chr_breaches: The siege destroyed buildings: $1 - Builders will put them back with materials from the chests
aoj_members_bonus: Every member makes the settlement bigger: settlers $1 (tier alone: $2), radius $3 m ($4 m), +$5 places at every totem
aoj_members_candidates: Players at the table (not members yet):
aoj_members_no_candidates: To admit a player, stand at the table together
aoj_ranks_help: Jarl - everything, Hersirs and a co-Jarl too (up to 2 Jarls by default) · Hersir - work and totems, dismissals, the tier and name, the Karl and Huscarl ranks · Huscarl - alarm, combat roles, banners, battle orders · Karl - brings in their settlers, everyday orders, feasts · Guest - looks only. Every member makes the settlement bigger.
aoj_shared_bonus: Shared settlement ($1 members): settlers ×$2, radius +$3%, +$4 places at the totems
aoj_rank_hint: Your rank: $1 - Hersirs and Jarls run the settlement
aoj_msg_rank_denied: Your rank does not allow that
aoj_msg_rank_same: That player already has this rank
aoj_msg_rank_senior: Only the senior Jarl can demote another Jarl
aoj_msg_last_jarl: The settlement needs a Jarl - appoint a co-Jarl or hand the title over first
aoj_msg_jarls_full: The settlement has the most Jarls it can ($1) - you can hand your title over
aoj_msg_rank_full: The settlement has the most members it can
aoj_msg_settler_down: falls in battle but will live
aoj_unlock_fast_healing: twice as fast healing in bed
aoj_chr_dismissed_by: $1 has to leave the settlement (banished by $2)
aoj_chr_feast_by: $1 holds a feast! Morale rises for two days
aoj_chr_member_left_by: $1 is no longer a member (decided by $3)
aoj_chr_handover: $1 becomes Jarl - title handed over by $2
aoj_storage_hint: Shift+E on a chest in the settlement sets what goes into it (wood, ores, food...). Chests without one sort themselves by what they hold.
aoj_work_auto_hint: Free civilians take free places at the totems on their own - high priority first (set it in the totem window).
aoj_work_manual_hint: You assign work yourselves: in the totem window (Assign) or in the settler window.
aoj_problem_no_tree_seeds: no tree seeds in the chests (pine cones, acorns, beech seeds...)
aoj_captive_how: beat the guards or break the bars
aoj_problem_no_materials: no materials in the chests to rebuild with
aoj_breaches_waiting: Destroyed buildings to rebuild: $1 (Builders take the materials from the chests)
